metadata.description: Azure region for all regional resources.
Short prefix used in resource names (lowercase letters/numbers, max 8).
App Service plan SKU. B1 is fine for testing; P0v3 or higher recommended for production.
Container image for the public site.
Container image for the admin portal.
Container image for the HLS encoder job.
Entra ID tenant for admin sign-in. Defaults to the tenant you deploy from.
Client (application) ID of the admin portal app registration. Leave empty to deploy with the admin portal locked, then run scripts/configure-admin-auth.ps1.
Mailbox(es) that receive contact / suggestion / demo form submissions (comma separated). Optional.
Object ID of a user or group that should be able to run the data importer from a workstation (Cosmos + Blob data access). Optional.
Optional IP ranges (CIDR) allowed to reach the admin portal. Empty = reachable from anywhere (still requires Entra sign-in).
Data residency for Azure Communication Services.
Region for Cosmos DB. Defaults to the resource group region. Set another region (for example northeurope) if Cosmos DB reports no capacity for your subscription.
